research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Rescale, Inc. is focused on enhancing cloud simulation platforms through the integration of computing resources from multiple hardware and software providers. Their R&D efforts include developing systems and methods for an integrated multi-provider platform that employs abstraction layers to manage interdependencies. Additionally, they are working on a compute recommendation engine designed to assist users in selecting infrastructure options that meet specific performance goals. These innovations aim to streamline the process of building, computing, analyzing, and scaling simulations in a cloud environment.

overview_description.description:
Rescale is a cloud simulation platform that enables research scientists and engineers to build, compute, analyze, and scale simulations.

The high-performance computing cloud platform delivers intelligent computing for digital R&D and enables more than 300 customers, from startups to Fortune 50 enterprises, to accelerate design cycles and time to market. Rescale gives research scientists and engineers the ability to run their simulation and artificial intelligence workloads on the cloud provider of their choice, using specialized hardware architectures and software templates optimized for their use cases, without any set-up or maintenance. Investors such as Initialized Capital, Keen Venture Partners, SineWave Ventures, Data Collective, ITV Ventures, Jump Capital, and M12 (formerly Microsoft Ventures), as well as Mitsubishi UFJ Capital, Quiet Capital, Streamlined Ventures, Translink Capital, Two Roads Group, Y Combinator, Hitachi Ventures, Nautilus Venture Partners, NVIDIA, Republic Labs, and Samsung Catalyst Fund backs Rescale.

about_short_description.short_description: Rescale is a cloud simulation platform that enables research scientists and engineers to build, compute, analyze, and scale simulations.

product.name: Rescale Digital Engineering Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for running HPC workloads, managing modeling and simulation workflows, connecting engineering data, and applying AI to research and product development.

product.name: Rescale High Performance Computing (HPC)
product.description: Elastic cloud HPC infrastructure for running engineering and scientific workloads with configurable hardware, preconfigured applications, and automated resource management.

product.name: Rescale Advanced Modeling and Simulation
product.description: An automated environment for configuring, running, and analyzing engineering simulations across applications, hardware, data, and multi-step workflows.

product.name: Rescale AI Physics
product.description: An end-to-end system for preparing simulation data, training surrogate models, deploying them, and running fast AI-based inference for engineering analysis.

product.name: Rescale Agentic Digital Engineering
product.description: AI-assisted engineering automation that uses task-specific agents to orchestrate simulations, monitor jobs, troubleshoot failures, analyze results, and generate reports.

product.name: Rescale Enterprise Management
product.description: Administrative capabilities for controlling engineering compute, applications, data access, security policies, licensing, and spending across teams and environments.
